title: TypeScript
label: TypeScript
desc: Typed superset of JavaScript whose compiler catches mistakes before the code runs.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install the compiler and a runner, then execute a first typed file.

snippets.code:
# Create a package and install the compiler plus a fast runner
npm init -y
npm install --save-dev typescript tsx @types/node

# Check the installed versions
npx tsc --version
npx tsx --version

# Run the file directly, without an emit step
npx tsx hello.ts

# Or compile it and run the JavaScript output
npx tsc hello.ts
node hello.js

sections.title: tsconfig
sections.description: Compiler options that keep a project strict, explicit and fast to check.

snippets.code:
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "lib": ["ES2022"],
    "module": "NodeNext",
    "moduleResolution": "NodeNext",
    "rootDir": "src",
    "outDir": "dist",
    "strict": true,
    "noUncheckedIndexedAccess": true,
    "noImplicitOverride": true,
    "exactOptionalPropertyTypes": true,
    "verbatimModuleSyntax": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "sourceMap": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true
  },
  "include": ["src/**/*.ts"],
  "exclude": ["dist", "node_modules"]
}

npx tsc                    # read tsconfig.json in the current directory
npx tsc --noEmit           # type-check only, the CI-friendly form
npx tsc --watch            # rebuild whenever a source file changes
npx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
